```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{LinearSearch}{$A[1..n],x$}
      \For{$i \gets 1$ \textbf{to} $n$}
        \If{$A[i]=x$}
          \State \Return $i$
        \EndIf
      \EndFor
      \State \Return $\NotFound$
    \EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
